title: A Game Combining Human and AI Art Creation and Critique
author: SlapstickMojo
selftext: I'm imagining a game that combines AI image generation, Procreate/Krita, and Eastshade. One where you explore the world, pull out a canvas, and use an in-game painting app to make artwork. You can paint what you see, or anything you like. The other characters can look at your art -- maybe look at the scene you painted from -- and using AI image analysis, comment on it, what they like, critiques. And you wouldn't be alone -- there would be NPCs using AI image generators to make their own paintings, and you could use an LLM interface to tell them what you think of their work, ask them questions about it. There could even be an online element, where there is a mix of Ai NPCs and other human players, all making art and displaying them. Gameplay elements could involve unlocking new areas to explore (and paint) or new items to decorate with (like still lives) or meeting new people (portraits).

comments.author: Leon_Erdna
comments.body: This is a great idea! The first thing that comes to mind will be to limit the possible responses and discussions with these AI! To prevent it from going in all directions!
